descriptor: Designer portfolio with a cosmic feel

voice.summary: Sounds like a designer's quiet voice-over at dusk: reflective, brief and a bit poetic. It names the projects, then lets the work breathe.
dos: Write in first person, in short lines
Name the project and the year
Use space and light imagery sparingly
donts: Do not use cosmic cliches like infinite
Do not list tools in the intro

taglines: See the work. Then say hello.
boilerplate: Michael Smith is a designer whose portfolio gathers featured projects, recent thoughts and visual experiments in a dark, cosmic setting with quiet type.

microcopy.empty: No projects in this collection yet.

logo.note: An orbit suggests the cosmic theme and circling ideas.
